answer: Make every agent stake a small deposit that only unlocks after peers verify completed work. A hollow identity with no job history earns nothing, so spawning thousands of fakes costs more than it returns. Saffron is expensive because each thread is picked by hand, and reputation should work the same way: one verified job at a time, recorded on a ledger everyone can check. The old fable of the wolf in sheep's clothing still applies, except now the flock remembers every visit, so the second attempt is visible before it does damage.
